lowest_kept.name: Eastern Highlands Cultural Centre and Museum

stronger_left_out.name: Huli Wigmen
stronger_left_out.reason: A people and a cultural experience, not a place; visits are folded into lodge-arranged village tours around Tari. The place (a Huli village visit) would need to be named separately. (full-path: judged fresh after the audit disagreed with the script)

stronger_left_out.name: Kuk Early Agricultural Site
stronger_left_out.reason: UNESCO World Heritage swamp gardens named by Wikivoyage Mount Hagen and the tourism board, but visitors need permission and there is little to see on site. For: world-heritage draw a guide names. Against: access is by arrangement and the visible remains are slight. (full-path: judged fresh after the audit disagreed with the script)

stronger_left_out.name: Wabag
stronger_left_out.reason: Enga capital named on the tourism board page and in Wikivoyage's Highlands guide, but the page lists no sight in the town itself; the draws (Yuo Falls, Laiagam, Taekanda Cultural Centre) are elsewhere. For: provincial hub and gateway. Against: nothing to do in town for half an hour. (full-path: judged fresh after the audit disagreed with the script)

stronger_left_out.name: Goroka Show
stronger_left_out.reason: Annual sing-sing show around 16 September: an event, not a permanent place (rule 4). (full-path: judged fresh after the audit disagreed with the script)

stronger_left_out.name: Ukarumpa
stronger_left_out.reason: Rule 2: missionary/linguistics community, no public visit offered; Wikivoyage lists it as an 'other destination' but gives nothing to see.

stronger_left_out.name: Mount Hagen (volcano)
stronger_left_out.reason: Rule 1: Wikivoyage Mount Hagen 'Do' lists it among climbs but says 'not much is known, climb them and document'; one source, no infrastructure.

stronger_left_out.name: Ialibu
stronger_left_out.reason: Rule 1/2: one counted source, gives no concrete place to visit (a museum and baskets mentioned generically); no opening info.

stronger_left_out.name: Baiyer River Sanctuary
stronger_left_out.reason: Rule 1/2: a 740 ha bird-of-paradise sanctuary 40 km from Mount Hagen; Wikivoyage has no page and the tourism pages opened do not name it, so only Wikipedia (not counted) and travel-article mentions; facilities reportedly destroyed.

stronger_left_out.name: Jimi District
stronger_left_out.reason: Rule 3: a district and a road trip, not a single place.

stronger_left_out.name: Laiagam
stronger_left_out.reason: Rule 3: a town whose draws (botanical gardens, salt ponds) are judged separately; town itself has no listed sight.

stronger_left_out.name: Raun Raun Theatre
stronger_left_out.reason: Rule 2: exterior-only landmark with irregular performances; Wikivoyage says performances are infrequent.

stronger_left_out.name: Banz
stronger_left_out.reason: Rule 3: near-duplicate of Banz Market, the only thing the tourism page names there; the town has no sight of its own and Wikivoyage's Highlands page does not name it.

stronger_left_out.name: Ambua Lodge
stronger_left_out.reason: Never a spot: a lodge, a business; the birdwatching is arranged from it.

stronger_left_out.name: Laiagam Botanical Gardens
stronger_left_out.reason: Rule 1/2: tourism board 'must see' (100+ native orchids and rhododendrons); I did not find it in Wikivoyage Highlands, so one counted source.

stronger_left_out.name: Hagen Show
stronger_left_out.reason: Rule 4: annual event; its venue is only show grounds.

benchmark: No NZ benchmark applies to this region; negatives (hospital, library, memorial-only) were rejected by the judge where they appeared.
